evidence.claim: TELTEC distribuisce apparecchiature e materiali per semiconduttori e fotovoltaico in Europa, con quasi 150 persone, aprendo il mercato europeo ai produttori di medie dimensioni.
evidence.quote: TELTEC is Europes leading Semiconductor & PV Equipment and Materials Distributor and Representative. || With nearly 150 employees in six countries, TELTEC is currently and will continue to be the dominant force in the semiconductor industry. || TELTEC offers swift and straightforward access to the European market for medium-sized manufacturers, catering to their specific needs. Renowned chip manufacturers simultaneously benefit from an innovative and versatile portfolio.
